params.prompt: Create a portrait of ONE man by combining two references. Take the AGE, SKIN and YOUTH from the FIRST reference image: a man of twenty-five — smooth taut young skin with no lines anywhere, full firm cheeks, thick jet-black hair with no grey, clear bright eyes, a young light moustache. Take the FACIAL STRUCTURE and IDENTITY from the SECOND reference image: his face shape, his brow, his eye placement and eye shape, his nose, his mouth, his strong jaw and cheekbones — the same man, recognisably. The result is that same man at twenty-five years old: his bone structure, a young man's skin. Plain white cotton kurta, fair wheat-golden Malwa complexion. Sharp photorealistic portrait, natural window light, plain neutral background, 85mm, front-facing, looking into the lens. No text anywhere.
